labels = km.labels_

import numpy as np

indicators = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ("city_id", "city_name", "year")]
num = df[indicators].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

# median imputation
med = num.median(numeric_only=True)
X = num.fillna(med)

# standard scaling (StandardScaler: population std)
Xs = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10).fit(Xs)
labels = km.labels_

out1 = df[["city_id", "city_name", "year"]].copy()
out1["cluster_id"] = labels
out1.to_csv("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv", index=False, quoting=None)

# profiles: mean of raw (original) indicator values per cluster, over non-missing
prof = num.assign(cluster_id=labels)
means = prof.groupby("cluster_id")[indicators].mean()
means = means.reset_index()
means.to_csv("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv", index=False)

print(len(df), "rows")
print(means)
print(out1["cluster_id"].value_counts().to_dict())
